news.title: Captions and pings
items: When you share a clip or photo, a box now pops up with a preview so you can add a caption (optional) before it posts
If you have linked Discord, the SEND IT bot pings you in #clips when it posts your clip, so your friends know it was you
Changed your mind? Press EDIT CAPTION after posting and the post in #clips updates straight away
Captions are cleaned up before they post: links and @mentions are taken out and swear words are blanked
Signing in or linking with Discord can now add you to the SEND IT Discord server too. Untick the box if you don't want that. Already linked? Press "join the SEND IT Discord" in the Online tab

news.title: Discord status fix
items: Your Discord status timer no longer resets when you move to another place, open the map or a menu, change ride or level up. It counts from when you opened the game
Your Discord status now shows your level on every screen, plus what you are doing: riding, walking, watching a replay, taking photos or looking at the map
The place on your status only changes once you have been somewhere new for a few seconds, so it no longer flickers between two areas

news.title: Share to Discord
items: Share your best moments to the SEND IT Discord: open a replay (V) and press X. The replay is recorded as a video with the music and posted in #clips
In photo mode (P) press X to post the photo
Clips have a SEND IT watermark with your name and where you were riding. You need to be signed in, and can share once every 90 seconds

news.title: Discord is live
items: SEND IT is now connected to its own Discord app: with the newest SEND IT app, your Discord profile shows Playing SEND IT with where you ride

news.title: Smoother, softer, overhead
items: Overhead tricks on Y: push your bike, scooter or board up above your head in the air
Hop off rails: jump while grinding to pop off to the side you steer (right if you do not). You no longer land straight back on the same rail
The Big Bowl drop-in moved to the middle of the long side, so you drop straight into the bowl
Quiet sounds of the world: birds in the parks, a far-off traffic hum in town, waves by the sea, a crowd at The 100, footsteps, metal on rails and pavement joints under your wheels
Less lag: lighter High setting, fewer far-away details, and if the game runs slow it turns the graphics down for you (until you pick a setting yourself)
Softer menus and HUD with rounded corners
Grass no longer fills the screen when the camera is right next to it

news.title: SEND IT on Discord
items: Discord now shows you as Playing SEND IT, with where you are riding, your ride and level, and a picture of the place
When you are in an online server your friends see how many are riding and get a Join my server button
Turn it off any time in Settings → General → Show on Discord
Needs the newest SEND IT app (update it in the launcher)

news.title: Loading fix
items: Fixed the game getting stuck on LOADING if your rider wore a cap or nothing on their head
If the game ever hits a problem while starting, the loading screen now says what went wrong

news.title: Real people, real places
items: New riders and people: proper human bodies with real faces, hands that grip the bars and clothes with fabric texture. Built from the free MakeHuman models
Four body types around town, women with longer hair, short and long sleeves, jeans and joggers
New full-face helmet with an eye port, goggles, a peak and a painted design, and a hood and drawstrings on your hoodie
Leafy trees with real branches instead of the old blobs
New lighting: filmic colour, a deeper sky and stronger sunlight
The Kickflip Arms is a proper pub now: two storeys of brick, sash windows, a slate roof with chimneys, a hanging sign, flower baskets and benches outside. It is at the far end of Market Street
Shops have window frames, awnings and roof details
Cleaner menus and HUD: bigger text, solid panels and a speed dial

news.title: The 100
items: The 100: a 100 m tall roll-in inside a stadium, with a huge gap to clear. Take the lift at the bottom (unlocks at level 9)
Pro scooter redesign: tall wide T-bars, coloured grips, a printed deck and coloured wheel cores
An 8 m drop-in tower with railings on the Big Bowl deck. The Big Bowl now starts you on top of it
A foam pit in The Warehouse with a kicker into it: land anything
The update log now shows every version since 1.0
2 new goals

news.title: The launcher
items: New: the SEND IT Launcher. It installs the game, updates it by itself and starts it with one click (get it from the website)
Sponsor signs don't cut their names off any more

news.title: Unlocks, admins and the Big Bowl
items: Rides unlock as you level up: skateboard at level 2, e-scooter at 3, e-bike and surfboard at 4, skis at 6
New places unlock too: Wood Park (3), Islands (4), The Warehouse (5), Peak Run (6), The Big Bowl (7), Rooftop Park (8). Ride there yourself to unlock a place early
The Big Bowl: a massive 4.5 m deep concrete bowl with a deep end and a corner pocket
SEND IT is a desktop game now: it runs in the Windows and Mac app only
Admins: give or take coins, kick anyone from any server, and ban players for a set time
Hosts can kick players from their own server (Online tab)
Cleaner menus: leaderboards grouped down the side, goals on their own page, settings split into General, Sound, Controls and About
Quest card and your next unlock on the PLAY screen
Skins split into shop skins and quest rewards

news.title: Get off and explore
items: Get off your ride (F) and walk, run (Shift) and jump anywhere
Market Street: DcMonalds, Kurger Bings, Barstucks, Ocset and The Kickflip Arms, with people working inside
Buy food and drinks with coins, keep them in your bag (B) and eat them for a speed boost
7 quests: talk to people, find what they lost and bring it back for coins and a unique outfit (G for the quest log)
Dialogue that types out letter by letter, and people who talk out loud
Surfing: ride or walk into the sea and you get a surfboard. Catch waves, get air off them
5 islands out at sea, each with a treasure chest of coins (refills every day)
Snowy mountain: hire skis at the ski hut, take the chairlift and ski the Peak Run
Press S to ride backwards
All rides are faster
Punch people (J on foot). Some fight back, some run away, some just tell you off
Knocking people over looks real now: they fly, bounce, lie there and get back up (sometimes angry)
People walking their dogs (you can pet them), and drivers in the cars
17 new skins with hats and capes: Retro Hero, Pirate, Wizard, Knight, Robot, Astronaut, King and more
20 new goals and 5 new leaderboards: XP, treasure, longest surf, Peak Run and Woods downhill
Change any control in Settings
This update log!
Plaza 7-stair: grinding the handrail down it counts now too

news.title: Flips
items: Tap W or S in the air to do a full flip (hold for a double)
Flips work on the e-scooter

news.title: Fixes
items: Fixed the Plaza 7-stair goal

news.title: The ultra update
items: Skateboard
Big Air, Downtown, Canyon, Woods, Vert ramp, Airbag and Desert line
New menu, ride picker and world map
Levels, XP and daily challenges
Photo mode and instant replay
Day/night cycle
Lots more tricks and named combos

news.title: Radio fix
items: Fixed a low rumble that built up on 808 FM

news.title: Fair scores
items: Fixed a scoring exploit where spamming trick buttons stacked dozens of whips for millions of points
Repeating a trick in the same combo pays less each time
The combo multiplier tops out at ×12 and one combo pays at most 2,500 coins
A whip only counts if it is nearly finished when you land

news.title: Automatic updates
items: The game updates itself: it checks when it starts and every 30 minutes, downloads the new version in the background and offers Restart now
Your saves are kept across updates
Version number shown in Settings

news.title: Smoother and louder
items: Quieter, smoother ride sounds with no more buzzing
Separate Music and Sound effects sliders
Traffic drives faster (about 55–75 km/h)
Ride into someone fast and you knock them flat; they get back up a few seconds later

news.title: Online
items: New menu with Play, Garage, Online, Ranks and Settings tabs
Accounts: sign up with a username and password or sign in with Discord. Coins, upgrades, skins and goals save online
Coins for tricks: every combo you land pays coins
Avatars: design your face or upload your own picture
Leaderboards: best combo, Trick Attack, Hill Bomb, biggest air and most coins
Server list: join public servers in one click or host public or friends-only servers
Friends: add people, see who is online and join them
Invites and invite links
4 new paint jobs (pixel camo, rainbow, lava, diamond) and 4 new skins (ninja, ice, toxic, royal)

news.title: Three new places
items: New logo and app icon
Hill Bomb: a 36 m downhill road with five tabletops and a timed race
Seafront: beach, promenade rails, a concrete bowl and a pier to launch off into the sea
Construction Yard: jump a double-decker bus, ride containers and a giant concrete pipe
More ramps along the high street
Garage: 5 upgrades per ride, 10 paint jobs and 8 rider outfits
Radio: 5 stations made live in the game
Trick Attack: score as much as you can in 2 minutes
5 new goals

news.title: Multiplayer and grinds
items: Multiplayer rooms with a 4-letter code, name tags, a scoreboard and chat
Grinds on any rail, ledge, bench or the fountain rim
7 trick buttons per ride, plus stoppies and nose manuals
Easy mode and Pro mode
Slow-mo on big airs
The Plaza: granite deck, 7-stair with handrails, banks, ledges and a fountain
A living city: traffic, people on the pavements, murals and billboards
Time of day: day, sunset or night
Collect S-E-N-D-I-T letters and 14 goals

news.title: First release
items: Bike, e-bike, scooter and e-scooter
Flips, spins, tailwhips, barspins and wheelies
Skatepark, dirt jumps, the mega ramp and the high street
